purpose: Build one real-product cohort and compare decision behavior without inventing missing truth or declaring a business winner before outcome evidence exists.

CURRENT_HUNT.rule: Record current HUNT shadow eligibility exactly as represented by existing shelf evidence; do not reinterpret it as live sell readiness.

DETERMINISTIC_BDIF.rule: Run the canonical BDIF kernel with hard truth requirements and UNKNOWN fail-closed behavior.

MODEL_ASSISTED_BDIF.rule: Must use actual model outputs with model/version/cost/latency captured. Never fabricate model results.

readiness_levels.COHORT_REAL_PRODUCT: Product exists in current HUNT shadow evidence with supplier identity and product id.
readiness_levels.GATE_BENCHMARK_READY: Exact variant, stock and destination shipping are VERIFIED for the evaluated market.
readiness_levels.FULL_PILOT_INPUT_READY: All required product fields including target price, estimated margin and media quality are verified/proven for the evaluated market.
readiness_levels.BUSINESS_OUTCOME_READY: Real order/outcome evidence exists and realized economics can be attributed without inference.

evaluation_rules: The same selected 1,000 products are used for every lane.
Unknown, stale or conflicted evidence remains non-PASS.
Current HUNT shadow shelf status is not treated as live sell readiness.
Gate correctness may be measured before launch; business-profit superiority may not be claimed until real outcomes exist.
Model-assisted results remain NOT_RUN until real model execution is captured.
No Production deploy, live payment, supplier order, price mutation or fulfillment activation is permitted by this pilot.

margin_reference.note: Used only where existing verified shadow economics are present; never invented for suppliers without verified economics.
